text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One afternoon...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Wow, this place is great! ♪ The sunshine
feels so
nice!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Just letting off some of steam by breaking free of the normal day-to-day and having a little vacance!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She has a folding table with her, upon
which sits
some fruit and a tropical drink.
It looks like she's
enjoying a proper
vacation out here.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Sigh... Nothing's going to plan...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Oh dear, you seem really troubled, El.
How about
we have a little
refresh-and-recharge together?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Nnngh... sorry. Right now, I just wanna
focus on
my running. I haven't been in
top form lately.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
That's all the more reason you need a
break! You
need to refill your energy
gauge if you want to
face your problems
properly!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Stretch out under the sun, and you'll
feel much
better! Now come over, lie
down, and reach your
arms toward the
sky!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Join us too, Trainer! Okay, you ready,
El? Let's do
this!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Uh, like this?! Am I doing it right?!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, that's the spirit! Doesn't feeling
the
sunshine on your skin just lift a huge
weight off
your shoulders?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
It's so toasty and warm! I feel like I'm
getting
bundled up in the scent of the
sun...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Sigh... All the tension's leaving my body. Wow, I nearly forgot, but... es mi amigo el sol...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
That's right, just let all your stress and
worries go,
and enjoy a lovely little
holiday getaway under
the warm sun! ♪

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Kentucky... How I miss your green
pastures!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Oh dear, Taiki. Are you feeling
homesick? You
should try some deep
breathing exercises when
you're feeling
like that.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Close your eyes and take in a deep
breath. Then,
let your body feel the
sun's heat and take in the
smell of the
flora around you!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: I suppose I could give it a try... Inhaaale... Huh? This smell...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
It's the scent of dazzlin' sunshine and
fresh green
grass! Wow! It really feels
like I'm in Kentucky!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
You may be in a different country, but
you're
under the same sun! All right, let's
let loose and
play like we're kids again!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Yeehaw! Time to indulge ourselves!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
It's an imaginary vacance back home! ♪
Let's run
wild under the bright blue sky!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to Seeking the Pearl, the two of
them
become fully immersed in their
vacations,
escaping their everyday lives
for the moment.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Since we go full throttle every day, our
hearts can
get worn down before we
know it. That's why it's
important to
recover by resting as hard as we can.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
That's what all-out vacances are for! ♪
So we can
stretch out our wings and fully
recharge our
vitality!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
We shouldn't hog this experience to
ourselves,
either. Let's invite some other
students to join in
on the fun!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Take a mini vacance and say bye-bye to
the
stress of your everyday lives. ♪ The
time you take
off today will become
your energy for tomorrow!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Hehe... This does feels nice. It's been so
long
since I cast my worries aside and
just sunbathed.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Fun activities are essential for a good
break too!
Let's strengthen our bodies
while we enjoy the
sunshine!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
The power of the sun is making my
punches cut
like the wind! Who thinks
they can take me? Bring
it on!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Before long, a huge group of
Umamusume has
gathered around us.
They all enjoy their a little
vacation in
their own way and savor their
temporary
escape from the ordinary.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Everyone, welcome to your mini vacance!
Forget
about the bustle of life and make
the most of
today! ♪

text_block_list.name: Students
text_block_list.text: Yaaaaay! ♪ Vacations are the best!

text_block_list.name: Students
text_block_list.text: Yaaaaay! ♪ Vacations are the best!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Of course! People tend to forget, but
the sun's
energy is very powerful!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
It's all about how you view the world.
Even a
patch of grass can turn into a
world-class bed!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
C'mon, Trainer! Let's dive into this
vacance! ☆

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Everyone longs in the hearts to escape
their
everyday routine.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Which is why it's my duty to propose a
break that
will open you up and help
you relax!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
No doubt, there are still loads of people
in need
of a refresh!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Let's keep treating them to the best
relaxation
they could ask for!
